game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Exponent Engine: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: In Obsidian Quarry, repeat each round: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the engine_power value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ember furnace using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The ember furnace reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the ember furnace is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Exponent Engine
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Exponent Engine' (Week 2 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Obsidian Quarry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how engine_power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ember furnace reached with actions_used <= 17.
